svg.title: Three Transformer model families
svg.desc: Encoder-only Transformers use bidirectional self-attention, encoder-decoder Transformers combine a bidirectional encoder with a causal decoder that cross-attends to encoder output, and decoder-only Transformers use causal self-attention. Typical objectives and model examples are shown.

g.text: Architecture changes which positions each representation can use
tokens can use left + right context
each token sees only its prefix
